newsitem.title: FRANCE: Varig to raise Paris-Brazil cargo capacity.
newsitem.headline: Varig to raise Paris-Brazil cargo capacity.

text.p: Brazilian airline, Varig, said cargo capacity on its daily Paris-Sao Paulo-Rio passenger service is set to rise significantly later in the Spring.

"From June 2, an MD11 aircraft will replace a DC10 on the route which will at least double cargo lift on the route, offering between 12 and 14 tonnes of capacity per flight," a Paris-based Varig cargo official told Reuters.
"Demand is still strong on the route and additional cargo capacity has been planned for some time," he added.
In the first two months of 1997, Paris airfreight exports to Sao Paulo totalled 2,266 tonnes, up 70.9 per cent on January-February 1996, Paris airport authority figures showed.
Varig is to raise its ex-Paris cargo rates by an average of eight percent, effective April 1.
The carrier increased its ex-Paris cargo rates by a similar amount in October 1996.

Varig's Paris cargo station also trucks freight to Amsterdam and Frankfurt on a regular basis where it is transferred on to the airline's full-freighter services to Brazil. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
